probes.says: MUST FAIL: a maxed stat leaves its multiplier at 1.0
MUST FAIL: spending on a real stat with no points succeeds
MUST BE UNDETERMINED: references a global that does not exist
MUST BE UNDETERMINED: returns a number, not a boolean

_comment: The guard on the guard. A probe harness that reports everything green is worth nothing until it has been shown to report red. Each of these has a known answer: three must come back false, two must come back undetermined (an undefined global, and an expression that returns a number rather than a boolean), one must come back true. If this file ever runs all green, the harness has stopped discriminating and every other result it gives is meaningless.
